RTI reveals over ₹262 crore spent on Rajya Sabha MPs in two years

An RTI query has revealed that over ₹262 crore was spent on Rajya Sabha MPs in the past two years. The expenditure details were disclosed following a Right to Information request. This information highlights the financial outlay associated with the functioning of the upper house of India's Parliament.
